skill.name: seo-meta-optimizer
skill.description: Creates keyword-focused URL, title tag, and meta description options with character counts, calls to action, and platform-specific recommendations.
skill.summary: Create concise SEO metadata variations for webpages and content campaigns.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting or ordinary SEO recommendations. The skill contains no executable shell commands, network reconnaissance, prompt injection, or other semantic security risk.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks delimit the resource path in Markdown. The line contains no Ruby, shell invocation, or executable command.
The backticks open a fenced example showing URL, title, and description text. They do not execute a shell command or instruct an agent to do so.
The line recommends adding a number or year to a title for freshness. It contains no network access, host discovery, scanning, or reconnaissance instruction.

content.user_title: Optimize SEO Titles and Meta Descriptions
content.value_statement: Weak or oversized metadata can reduce search visibility and clicks. This skill creates focused URL, title, and description variations within common length guidelines.
actual_capabilities: Suggests lowercase, hyphenated URL paths with the primary keyword near the beginning.
Creates three to five title tag and meta description variations.
Targets common title and meta description character ranges.
Integrates primary and secondary keywords into readable metadata.
Adds calls to action, benefits, power words, and emotional triggers.
Provides recommendations for WordPress, Astro, and Next.js metadata workflows.
limitations: Cannot guarantee rankings, click-through rates, or search engine display behavior.
Character counts do not ensure exact pixel-width compliance across devices.
Requires page content, target keywords, audience, and brand details for useful results.
Platform settings and generated components require environment-specific review and testing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Page Metadata
use_cases.description: Create URL, title, and description options that highlight product benefits and target purchase-focused keywords.

use_cases.title: Refresh Editorial Search Snippets
use_cases.description: Rewrite outdated article metadata with current dates, clearer benefits, and natural keyword placement.

use_cases.title: Define Framework Metadata
use_cases.description: Prepare validated metadata copy and implementation guidance for Astro or Next.js pages.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three URL, title, and meta description options for [page topic]. Use the primary keyword [keyword] and brand [brand].
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a first metadata package for one webpage.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Existing Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this title and description: [metadata]. Preserve accuracy, target [keyword], show character counts, and provide three alternatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Refresh metadata that is unclear, long, or poorly targeted.

prompt_templates.title: Build Campaign Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create five metadata variations for [page]. Target [audience] and [keywords]. Vary benefits, calls to action, and emotional triggers without keyword stuffing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare options for review or controlled testing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Platform Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [page content] and create metadata for [platform]. Include URL, title, description, counts, mobile risks, schema ideas, and implementation settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce a detailed package for a WordPress, Astro, or Next.js workflow.

output_examples.input: Create metadata for an online project management course targeting project management certification.
output: Title: Project Management Certification Course | Acme, 54 characters
Description: Build practical skills for project management certification with expert lessons and flexible study. Explore the Acme course today, 143 characters.

output_examples.input: Refresh metadata for a 2026 guide to small business accounting software.
output: Title: 10 Best Small Business Accounting Tools for 2026, 50 characters
Description: Compare 10 small business accounting tools for invoicing, reporting, and tax preparation. Find the right software for your team, 137 characters.

best_practices: Provide page content, search intent, primary keyword, secondary keywords, audience, and brand before requesting metadata.
Review every variation for factual accuracy, natural language, brand voice, and alignment with the page.
Validate character counts, rendered width, platform configuration, and search performance after implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not repeat keywords unnaturally or add claims that the page cannot support.
Do not reuse identical titles and descriptions across several pages.
Do not treat character targets as guarantees that search engines will display the exact text.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide page content, target audience, search intent, primary keyword, secondary keywords, brand name, and preferred tone.

faq.question: How many variations does the skill create?
faq.answer: The workflow recommends three to five variations for each URL, title, and meta description.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee higher search rankings?
faq.answer: No. Metadata supports relevance and clicks, but rankings depend on content quality, authority, technical SEO, competition, and search engine decisions.

faq.question: Can it optimize existing metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply the current title, description, page content, and target keywords for revised options with character counts.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It provides recommendations for WordPress with Yoast or Rank Math, plus metadata workflows for Astro and Next.js.

faq.question: Are character limits exact display limits?
faq.answer: No. Search displays vary by pixel width, device, query, and search engine rewriting, so rendered output still requires validation.
